## Describe your changes
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

## Issue ticket number and link
If resolving a bug, please link the issue here.

## Checklist before requesting a review
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have successfully launched `python ai_suite/main.py` without regressions
- [ ] If it is a UI change, I have attached screenshots
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and formatting
